# AI-Powered Conversation Compliance & Pharmacovigilance Platform (PharCovAI)

**Author:** Poorva Mittal

**Document Type:** Idea Paper & Timeline Execution Plan

---

## 1. Executive Summary

Pharmaceutical manufacturers carry regulatory responsibility for every patient and provider interaction occurring across their support ecosystem. However, most conversations remain unreviewed due to the limitations of manual Quality Assurance (QA) processes.

Current workflows review only 1–5% of conversations, leaving critical compliance, pharmacovigilance (PV), and operational risks undetected. As AI agents become increasingly embedded into patient support operations, regulatory scrutiny around AI-generated interactions is expected to increase significantly.

This proposal introduces a compliance intelligence extension built on top of AI Lens to enable:

- **UC01:** AI-assisted adverse event (AE) detection
- **UC02:** SOP adherence monitoring
- **UC03:** Audit-ready compliance workflows
- **UC04:** Unified multi-channel conversation review
- **UC05:** Human-in-the-loop regulatory decision making

The proposed MVP focuses on high-recall AE detection and triage workflows for pharmaceutical compliance teams.

![][image1]

## 2. Problem Statement

### Current Industry Challenges

Pharma manufacturers currently face several operational and compliance gaps:

#### Limited Conversation Visibility

- Manual QA reviews only a small percentage of patient-support interactions.
- The majority of conversations remain unmonitored.

#### Regulatory Exposure

- FDA 15-day adverse event reporting requirements create significant operational risk.
- Delayed identification of reportable events can expose manufacturers to compliance violations.

#### AI Governance Gap

- AI agents are increasingly participating in patient interactions.
- No centralized system exists to monitor or audit AI-agent behavior.

#### Fragmented Systems

- Voice, SMS, email, fax, and operational systems operate independently.
- Audit preparation often requires extensive manual reconciliation across platforms.

![][image2]

## 3. Product Vision

The vision is to transition pharmaceutical customers from manually reviewing approximately 5% of conversations to algorithmically evaluating 100% of interactions while maintaining human oversight for all regulatory determinations.

The solution extends AI Lens into a compliance intelligence platform capable of analyzing data sources:

- Voice conversations
- SMS interactions
- Email communications
- AI-agent interactions
- Human-assisted workflows

### Core Product Outputs

#### Adverse Event Detection

- High-recall AE identification
- Severity classification
- Suggested MedWatch fields
- Transcript and audio evidence
- Model provenance and explainability

#### SOP Adherence Monitoring

- Script adherence analysis
- Process deviation detection
- Agent-level scoring
- Trend analysis

#### Compliance Governance

- Unified triage workflows
- Audit-ready exports
- Reviewer traceability
- End-to-end audit logging

## 4. Strategic Opportunity

### Why This Problem Matters

Pharma companies are already investing in conversation intelligence overlays or attempting to build internal tooling. Existing solutions are not healthcare-native and do not provide AI governance capabilities tailored for pharmacovigilance workflows.

### Why Now

Several market shifts make this the right timing:

- Rapid adoption of AI agents in patient support programs
- Advancements in LLM-based conversation analysis
- Increased regulatory attention toward AI-driven workflows
- Existing the Company infrastructure and conversation data advantage

### Strategic Advantage for the Company

the Company already possesses:

- Established healthcare infrastructure
- Existing customer relationships
- Lens analytics platform foundation
- Historical conversation datasets
- AI workflow expertise

This creates a defensible market advantage in healthcare-specific compliance intelligence.

## 7. MVP Feature Prioritization

### V1 — MVP Features

| ID | Feature | Description | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F1 | Voice Call Ingestion | Ingest AI-agent and human conversation recordings | Dominant channel; no ingestion = no data to analyze |
| F2 | AE Detection Engine | High-recall adverse event classification | FDA 15-day mandate makes missed AEs the top risk |
| F3 | Case Queue | Reviewer workflow with severity-based prioritization | 100% coverage needs structured triage for reviewers |
| F4 | Case Detail View | Transcript, audio evidence, and MedWatch extraction | Consolidates evidence and MedWatch in one surface |
| F5 | Audit-Ready Export | Regulatory export package generation | Prerequisite for customer compliance sign-off |
| F6 | Studio Integration | Closed-loop remediation workflow | Closes detection-to-action loop via Studio |

### V1.5 Features

| ID | Feature | Description | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F7 | SOP Scoring | Script adherence monitoring | Next-priority use case (UC02) after AE detection |
| F8 | SMS & Email Ingestion | Multi-channel conversation support | Closes channel coverage gap beyond voice (UC04) |
| F9 | PV System Integration | Structured data export into PV systems | Eliminates manual re-entry into existing PV systems |

### V2 Features

| ID | Feature | Description | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F10 | Fax Intake Bridge | OCR ingestion and analysis | Completes full-channel coverage for compliance teams |
| F11 | Multilingual Support | Spanish-language support | Expands addressable market; equitable coverage |

### Deferred / Long-Term Features

| ID | Feature | Reason Deferred | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F12 | Real-Time Monitoring | Requires separate low-latency architecture | Batch analysis delivers 90%+ value within 90 days |
| F13 | Automated FDA Submission | Regulatory risk requires phased rollout | Human-in-the-loop (UC05) must be proven first |

## 8. Product Experience

### Primary Workflow

The MVP is designed around a reviewer-centric compliance workflow.

#### Core Experience Principles

- Prioritize reviewer efficiency
- Surface explainable AI evidence
- Maintain human-in-the-loop validation
- Reduce time-to-decision
- Provide audit-ready traceability

### Core Product Surfaces

#### 1. Triage Queue

Capabilities include:

- Severity-based prioritization
- Reviewer assignment
- Confidence scoring
- SLA countdown visibility
- Workflow status management

#### 2. Case Detail View

Capabilities include:

- Highlighted transcript spans
- Audio playback at detection timestamp
- Pre-filled MedWatch fields
- Reviewer confirmation and dismissal workflows
- Audit logging and model provenance

## 9. Customer Onboarding Strategy

Pharma onboarding should be treated as a regulatory implementation program rather than a standard SaaS setup.

### Onboarding Phases

| Phase | Activities |
| --- | --- |
| Pre-Contract | BAA/DPA negotiation, therapy scoping, compliance alignment |
| Technical Setup | SSO, RBAC, integrations, environment provisioning |
| Calibration | Threshold tuning and historical data validation |
| Soft Launch | Production dry-runs and operational validation |
| Steady State | Governance cadence and model reviews |

## 12. Go / No-Go Decision Framework

### Go Criteria

The pilot proceeds if:

- AE recall thresholds are achieved
- No confirmed production AE misses occur
- Reviewer workflows demonstrate measurable efficiency gains
- Both partners commit to commercial expansion
- Compliance counsel approves export workflows

### No-Go Triggers

The pilot pauses or terminates if:

- Recall rates fall below safety thresholds
- False-positive rates create operational burden
- Reviewer trust deteriorates
- Regulatory sign-off is blocked
- Production compliance failures occur

## 13. Strategic Recommendation

This initiative represents more than a standalone compliance product.

It establishes:

- A defensible healthcare AI governance platform
- A safety layer for scaling AI-agent adoption
- A differentiated compliance intelligence capability
- A reusable workflow foundation across multiple communication channels

The combination of existing infrastructure, proprietary healthcare data, and growing AI adoption creates a strong opportunity for the Company to become the system of record for AI-enabled pharmacovigilance and compliance operations.

## 14. Long-Term Vision

### 12-Month Success Indicators

Within 12 months, success would include:

- Multiple paying pharma customers
- Daily AE detection workflows in production
- Expanded channel coverage beyond voice
- Integrated PV system workflows
- Audit-ready regulatory acceptance
- Closed-loop Studio remediation workflows
- Inbound demand from non-pilot customers
